sources.title: Torch
sources.author: jpsweber
sources.changes: Converted torch.obj to glTF binary, scaled to 0.2 m long, turned to lie along +x with the lens at +x, lens no longer emissive, both materials opaque (the OBJ's transmission filter had made them glass)

sources.title: CC0 Flat Guns West
sources.author: Pichuliru
sources.changes: From the GLB files: rig baked into static meshes at rest and removed, stray icosphere removed, turned to lie on the side along +x with the muzzle at +x, renamed

sources.title: CC0 Flat Shaded Melee Weapons
sources.author: Pichuliru
sources.changes: Converted all 20 source OBJ meshes with their MTL palette material and shared T_PCL_Palette_c.png in Blender to self-contained GLBs; applied transforms, baked flat shading, kept the 1-unit-equals-1-metre scale, and oriented each long axis from the grip toward the striking end along +x. The OBJ MTL's palette path was resolved to the shared texture at the archive root.

sources.title: Pipe
sources.author: neincenets
sources.changes: Converted pipe.obj in Blender to a self-contained GLB; the download references a missing pipe.mtl, so applied a neutral metallic steel material. Scaled the model's 5.15-unit grip-to-upper-elbow length to 0.927 m, with the grip at the lower end and the strike anchor at the upper open end; oriented the long shaft along +x for upright holding.
